earnings_fetched_note: Alpha Vantage 3-month CSV + Finnhub day-of feed cross-checked. Lowe's reported today (Aug 19 BMO): net sales $24.0B (+1.6% YoY), comp sales +0.2%, adjusted EPS $4.40 (Confirmed-multiple). Target also reported today; adjusted EPS $2.05 vs $2.09 est., comp sales -3.2% stores / +4.3% digital per a single wire-syndicated source, not yet corroborated by a second outlet or SEC filing as of this run -- treated as provisional. TJX, Estee Lauder, Analog Devices also reported today. Walmart reports Aug 20 BMO.

events.name: Lowe's (LOW), Target (TGT), TJX, Estee Lauder, Analog Devices Q2/Q3 earnings
events.reason: Second day of the big-box retail earnings block, direct read-through on the Aug 14 retail-sales/consumer-sentiment miss and the Canada tariff situation. Lowe's confirmed-multiple; Target single-reliable-source pending SEC filing.

events.name: Canada Section 338 tariffs (50%) paused ~3 days after a Trump-Carney call
events.reason: Trump paused the tariffs less than two hours before the midnight deadline, citing a pending deal; Carney cites substantial progress but no finished text. New effective deadline roughly Friday Aug 21-22.

events.name: 20-Year Bond auction, $16B
events.reason: Monthly refunding cycle; when-issued yield recently indicated ~5.27%, which would be the tenor's highest since its 2020 reintroduction if it holds.

events.name: FOMC minutes, July 28-29 meeting
events.reason: First extended look at how the committee under Chair Kevin Warsh discussed the policy path before this month's inflation and labor data.

events.name: Walmart (WMT) Q2 FY2027
events.reason: Closes the week's big-box retail block; largest US retailer by revenue, a bellwether for consumer-spending health.

events.name: SpaceX (SPCX) share unlock, ~319 million shares (~20% of tradable float)
events.reason: Second major post-IPO share-eligibility event; stock has recovered above its $135 IPO price into the event after round-tripping sharply since the Aug 6 initial unlock. Distinct from the separate ~7% tranche around Aug 21.

events.name: Supreme Court's implicit deadline on the East Wing ballroom emergency application
events.reason: D.C. Circuit's injunction blocking construction otherwise takes effect Aug 21; Solicitor General has asked the Court to rule before then. Mail-ballot EO case also remains pending with no ruling.
events.source: SCOTUSblog, CBS News, PBS NewsHour -- Confirmed-multiple

events.name: SpaceX (SPCX) share-eligibility tranche, ~7% of shares
events.reason: Distinct from the Aug 20 unlock; analysts note share eligibility does not equal actual sale volume.
events.source: This report's own science/space research sweep -- Confirmed-multiple (mechanics/dates)

events.name: Long March 5 -- Chang'e 7 (lunar mission)
events.reason: Vehicle rolled out to the Wenchang pad Aug 19; China's space agency says the window remains on track, the clearest evidence yet the Aug 10 Long March 7A failure is not grounding the wider fleet. CASC has still not published a root-cause finding on that failure.
events.source: CGTN, China Manned Space Agency -- Confirmed-primary (rollout); System inference (fleet-grounding read)
